The board 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-03 Access board' and the viewer principal were created through the UI in failed attempt a2 (kept under attempts/) and reused here. The documented viewer noassign@emeraldcity.oz does not exist in the rebuilt Oz tenant, so QA created cm-review-20261026-03-viewer@emeraldcity.oz (Technician role) in Settings > Users.

sections.section: 1. Customer controls board and project scope
sections.note: Alice searched for the disposable board, added it with View, saved and reloaded; the View level persisted. She then switched to 'Escalated tickets only'. Both disposable tickets were denied to QA even though QA has a technician assignment. Alice escalated #000031 from its native ticket, after which QA could open it while #000032 stayed denied. Back in board oversight, #000032 opened again. Saving escalation-only clears every board grant (the editor empties the board list in that mode). Restoring oversight re-adds them, so the White Rabbit relationship had no board grants for 17 s (04:31:16.9Z to 04:31:33.8Z); Service Desk/Collaborate and the disposable board/View were re-added and verified. Escalation is blocked until the MSP has a client SLA policy and a mapping for the ticket's priority. QA temporarily assigned guide 08's 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-08 final-b MSP policy' to White Rabbit and mapped Critical to P1 (04:31:02Z to 04:31:47Z), then restored both to baseline.

The unassigned viewer opening the shared ticket URL was denied. In the White Rabbit client's Co-managed IT view, QA saved QA Tester as Collaborate (already present in the baseline) and the viewer as View; both persisted after reload. The board was approved only for View, so the technician could read but got no save bar. Alice's 'Private to' note on #000032 was not visible to the assigned technician.

sections.section: 3. Compare a viewer with a technician
sections.note: Alice raised the disposable board to Collaborate. In Entry, QA changed status Open to In Progress and saved; the value persisted after reload. No Tags control or category creation was offered. The viewer saw 'In Progress' read-only in both layouts: Category and Status disabled, no save bar. Uncertain observation: in Grid, the first button inside QA's category control reported disabled while Entry offered the picker. The screenshot (3-technician-grid.png) looks enabled and White Rabbit has no categories, so this is not claimed as a defect.

Before revocation, QA posted a Shared IT teams comment with a file on #000031 and downloaded it (200). Alice revoked #000031 in Individual ticket access with a handoff note; on reopening the page it was gone. QA could still read #000031 through the independent board grant. After Alice removed the disposable board from scope, both old URLs were denied and the captured attachment link returned 404. Fresh Customer oversight showed 0 rows and the fresh CSV export contained neither title. The export used the same search filter, so the CSV was header-only.

No operator-prepared restricted field policy exists in this environment. The guide says to verify such a policy through the shared screen and has no UI for creating one, so shared field redaction was not exercised.

Final scope: board_scope with Service Desk/Collaborate only, as in the baseline. QA technician is unchanged; the viewer assignment was removed through the MSP UI. Escalation prerequisites (White Rabbit client SLA policy, Critical mapping) are back to none/Not mapped.
